name: office-kart
description: Office Kart: browser-based online multiplayer kart racing

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @office-kart/game-server && npm run build -w @office-kart/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @office-kart/shared && npm run typecheck -w @office-kart/game-server && npm run typecheck -w @office-kart/web
